mainEntity.name: What are the common challenges when renting out a tiny home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common challenges include navigating local zoning and permitting, ensuring proper utility connections, and addressing tenant expectations for a smaller space. Marketing the tiny home to attract suitable tenants can also be a consideration. Maintenance, especially for homes on wheels, and potential issues with parking or access are other factors. Understanding and adhering to landlord-tenant laws is crucial. Zen Tiny Homes can help guide clients through the construction and permitting phases to minimize these challenges.
